specificFindings: Not all is partial negation,not none or guaranteed equal richness. The key question introduces conditions after the qualified possibility of indirect aesthetic richness.
As if describes imaginative participation in a narrative,not physical entry into a film location or a requirement to mistake fiction for historical fact. Immersion is not by itself sufficient.

The authors weekend-film forgetting is a personal illustration of insufficient retention,not a diagnosis or exact universal forgetting interval. Only to marks an unexpected result rather than purpose.

Remain vivid is an explicitly necessary condition in the authors argument,but the exercises do not infer vivid memory alone suffices. Retained experience is distinguished from a physically brighter screen.
Some sensation-seekers and do not seem retain person and epistemic limits. Global travel is not said to be universally worthless. They refers to that group,not all readers or high-income earners.
The high-income/spending and saving analogy concerns remembering and cherishing accumulated experiences. It is neither financial advice nor a literal equivalence of money and memory.
Lastly adds complexity and perspective change. Home Alone is granted immersion,fun and memorability while the authors own perspective did not change; this is not an all-audience movie ranking.

The reader-directed question invites reflection without inventing actual user viewing history. For me restricts Rashomon classification to personal appraisal rather than universal effects or mutable release dates.

Successive Rashomon accounts are both contradictory and convincing. Convincing presentation does not prove which version is objectively true. The final personal appraisal is connected to the authors reported hope shift,not ticket sales.

The Matrix and Parasite invitations are tagged limited-inference for audience accommodation. They are alternative examples,not website age restrictions or compulsory viewing. Answers do not depend on an unstated release year in the current parent.

Morpheus speaks the everywhere line. It refers to the Matrix,not a pill or another films event. All film dialogue remains fictional attribution,not a verified claim about internet technology or actual users surroundings.
This very room uses very for exact identity and proximity,not degree of room size. Even now is an elliptical continuation of the same quoted dialogue,not an independent observation of a users room.
Looking out the window provides a nearby ordinary-view image within the fictional speaker setting. No website window inspection,geolocation or real-world experimental proof is asserted.

What truth requests clarification of the preceding concealed-truth claim. Neo asks is a split attribution marker; the following Morpheus replies establishes questioner and respondent without exchanging them.

You are a slave,Neo addresses Neo by name. Like everyone else and born into bondage compare conditions in the fictional account,not real-reader diagnoses or a freely chosen condition after the conversation.
A prison for your mind is the closing fragment of Morpheus metaphor. It is not a literal police report,physical site restriction or evidence that a real users mind is controlled.

The Parasite introduction evidence is trimmed to its first target sentence,leaving later unassigned family/character material pending. Planned-evidence checks pass with exactly25 new IDs and all prior fingerprints retained.
